name: divergence-meter
description: shift to another worldline every hour (auto) or leap as you want (manual). The divergence meter is a Future Gadget tool from the visual novel Steins;Gate. The science fictional technology is based on the multiple line world theory (Everett III). Provoke a change in your worldline to change the divergence displayed on your desktop and travel accross many attractor fields (0%-4%)
author: Pixeloko
